integrity: The proof independently derives the all-order branch from the published equations, checks normalisability, and separates analytic proof from finite numerical corroboration. The source special case \(k=2\) is recovered exactly.
scientific_limitations: The result is confined to translation-invariant normalized boundary laws of the three-loop compatibility graph. It proves an at-least-five coexistence interval for \(k>2\), not an exact global count, and does not address extremality or thermodynamic dominance.
title: All-order tricritical threshold for the three-loop countable hard-core tree model
